ports.notes: Verified against theboy181/drmario64_recomp_plus's actual release - the one entry here launched end-to-end (download, extract, ROM auto-copy, launch) rather than only checked against the API.

macOS flipped true 27/09/2026: the stable release's .dmg only failed to install because ArchiveExtractAll tripped over the volume's unreadable .Trashes - fixed there. Verified end to end with --install-port (universal Mach-O, Developer ID signed) and a launch that reaches the game's own ROM prompt.

Linux and macOS flipped back to false 27/09/2026: v0.3.9 (22/09) ships only SuperMetroidSNESRecomp-windows-x64-v0.3.9.zip, where v0.3.4-v0.3.8 also had linux-x64 and macos-arm64/x64 zips. On a Mac --install-port now fails with "nenhum build macOS na release deste port"; Linux was not run here, but the one asset left has nothing PickLinuxAsset can match. Flip again if upstream brings them back.

Linux flipped true 21/09/2026: PickLinuxAsset now accepts .tar.gz directly (it didn't when this entry was first added, on 11/09 - see CREDITS.md's own note on this row, now stale) and the release still ships a real linux-x86_64.tar.gz. Verified end to end with --install-port, not just by re-reading the release assets. macOS flipped true 27/09/2026: v1.1.0 is the first release with a macos-universal.zip. Verified with --install-port (universal Mach-O .app, exe found inside Contents/MacOS) and a launch that reaches the game's own ROM prompt.
DevilutionX and Fallout1CE ship .dmg for macOS - native mounting via hdiutil in ArchiveExtractAll handles this seamlessly.

Xbox 360 static recomp. Verified 27/09/2026 against the real v0.1.2 release (prerelease-only repo - /latest 404s, the /releases fallback in DownloadAndInstall picks it up): one "-windows-x64.zip" with Launch.cmd at the root and the game in build_native/Release/. Arguments mirror what upstream's own DarkRecompPreview.exe passes ("play" mode): without --timeout-ms 0 the runtime quits itself after 30 s, and --engine-preview is the playable engine path. --game-dir is left at its default ("Darkness", relative to the working directory, which exe_relpath makes the port folder). No Linux/macOS build. Hidden since 27/09/2026: the dump pipeline is validated against a real disc and the game boots, but upstream's runtime is still far too broken to offer - see docs/XBOX360_RECOMP.md.

GameCube static recomp (PowerPC -> C++ plus Slippi's Gecko codes), D3D12/D3D11. Verified 27/09/2026 against the real v0.7.1 release: one "-win64.zip" wrapping a single MeleeUnlocked-<ver>/ folder (flattened on install). The pinned exe matters here: the alphabetical tie-break would pick MeleeUnlockedLauncher.exe, the project's optional launcher that updates itself into Versions/ - not something Karamelo should hand control to. Arguments are exactly MeleeUnlocked.bat's, with paths relative to the port folder (the working directory) and the ISO read in place from roms/GameCube/ rather than copied next to it as melee.iso. GUI subsystem, so no console to hide. Needs the NTSC 1.02 disc; the game itself checks the revision. No Linux/macOS build.

PSP static recomp of Monster Hunter Portable 3rd HD Ver. (Vulkan, SDL3, MIT). Releases ship Windows zip, Linux tar.gz (+ a Flatpak the picker skips), macOS .dmg and an Android .apk, next to an ffmpeg source tarball. No ROM handling here: the game's own first-run setup asks for the NPJB-40001 image, checks it and prepares the executable itself, gamepad-friendly.

Star Fox Adventures native port (SFA decompilation + Aurora), CC0-1.0. Verified 29/09/2026 against v1.0.7: the GitHub release carries no binaries - the project's launcher downloads them from api.foxhollow.dev/releases (public, newest first), one per OS: a Windows .zip with foxhollow.exe + DLLs at the root, a Linux x86-64 ELF and a native arm64 Mach-O, each alone in a .tar.gz. The disc path is argv[1]; the game reads .iso and .rvz in place and accepts GSAE01 1.0/1.1, GSAP01 1.0/1.1 and GSAJ01 1.0, so there is no header check here - an unsupported disc makes the game itself refuse it.

Conker's Bad Fur Day static recomp (CBFD-Recompiled / RT64, GPL-3.0). Official releases publish Windows zip, Linux tar.gz and native macOS (Apple Silicon) zip with ConkerRecomp.app. Assets include a separate Mods zip (filtered out by LooksLikeCompanionTool). Requires the original US ROM (.z64); passing --rom registers it into the game's local storage on first run and boots immediately.

ports.notes: Sly Cooper and the Thievius Raccoonus native PC port (ProjectCane, PS2 reverse engineering). Official releases publish Windows RAR (with game exe + File Extractor GUI) and a Linux RAR (portable AppImage + File Extractor GUI). Upstream has no macOS build. Requires game assets from NTSC PS2 ISO (SCUS-97198) extracted via File Extractor GUI.

Castlevania: Legacy of Darkness static recomp (cvlod_recomp / N64Recomp, GPL-3.0). Official releases publish Windows zip, Linux tar.gz and native macOS (Apple Silicon arm64) zip. Requires stock Castlevania: Legacy of Darkness USA ROM (.z64, ND4E). Accepts {rom} positional argument and rom.z64 in the port directory.

BLACK static recomp (original Xbox via XboxXBE-Recomp SDK), Direct3D 12. Official releases publish Windows zip (BLACK-XBERecomp.zip) containing BLACK.exe, d3dcompiler_47.dll and an assets/ directory. Game assets: the game reads default.xbe or an original Xbox .iso directly placed inside the assets/ directory (supports USA and Europe releases). Karamelo automatically resolves and links/copies the user's ISO from roms/Xbox/ into ports/BlackRecomp/assets/ if not already present.

CPS-2 Recomp (Capcom CPS-1 and CPS-2 arcade static recompilation by tmcleroy). Official releases publish Windows zip (CPS2Recomp-windows-x64.zip), Linux tarball (CPS2Recomp-linux-x86_64.tar.gz), and macOS zip (CPS2Recomp-macOS.zip with CPS-2 Recomp.app). Includes Street Fighter Alpha 2, Cadillacs and Dinosaurs, Alien vs. Predator, Super Puzzle Fighter II Turbo, Vampire Savior 1/2, Vampire Hunter 2, and Vampire Savior Definitive. Karamelo automatically copies available ROM sets from roms/Arcade (sfa2u.zip, dino.zip, avspu.zip, etc.) into ports/CPS2Recomp/ before execution.

Wayne Gretzky's 3D Hockey static recomp (N64 USA v1.0 via N64Recomp + RT64 by geno55). Official releases publish Windows zip (wg3d-recomp-v<ver>-windows-x64.zip) containing wg3d.exe, RT64 D3D12/Vulkan backends and MSVC runtime DLLs. Accepts original USA N64 ROM (.z64/.v64/.n64) as argument or copied to port directory.
Rush 2: Extreme Racing USA static recomp (N64 via N64Recomp by bryantmh). Official releases publish Windows zip (Rush2Recompiled-<ver>.zip) and Linux AppImage.
Automobili Lamborghini static recomp (N64 USA via N64Recomp + RT64 by alondero). Official releases publish Windows zip and Linux zip (lamborghini_modern).
Road Rash 64 static recomp (N64 USA v1.0 via N64Recomp by linkssy2). Official releases publish Windows zip and Linux Experimental AppImage.
Jungle Strike static recomp (SNES by Junior-Jones). Official releases publish Windows zip with Launcher.exe and Rom/ directory.

ICO native PC port (PS2 PAL SCES-50760 decompilation by nathanialf). Official releases publish Windows zip, Linux tarball and macOS (Apple Silicon arm64) dmg/zip. Accepts user's PAL disc image (.iso, .chd, .bin).

Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron native PC port (PSP via static recomp by GTTeancum). Official releases publish Windows zip (RenegadeSquadronPC). Direct3D 12, 60 FPS, twin-stick controls. The game reads the disc's PSP_GAME folder from data/ - it takes no ISO argument. PreparePspGame() extracts the user's US ISO (ULUS10292) there before the first launch. Only a plain .iso: a .cso is compressed and nothing here can unpack it.
